question: In the direct recycling of lithium-ion battery electrodes by solvent recovery with ethylene glycol, how much capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell retain after its 1000 cycles?
rendered:
Document title: Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials

The capacity degradation of the 1.4 Ah lithium-ion pouch cell after 1000 cycles is mentioned in the text on page 2 of the document:

"After 4 formation cycles at C/20, the pouch cell was charged/discharged at 1 C/2 C rates for 1000 cycles and the capacity degraded to 65.7% of its initial capacity (Figure S1 in the Supporting Information)."

So, the 1.4 Ah pouch cell retained 65.7% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles.
